scientific_integrity: Proof provided for every cycle size; bounded direct enumeration corroborates but does not replace the proof. Related known Dyck totals are explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Full adjacency-preserving graph endomorphisms only; neither weak nor partial endomorphisms.
The overall Dyck-path totals are already catalogued in OEIS A287709; the claim is the rank-stratified algebraic and dihedral unit-conjugacy enumeration.
Independent mathematical validation has not been performed; unindexed equivalent literature remains a risk.
title: Dihedral conjugacy and rank enumeration of retractions of finite cycles
